summary: You decide exactly who gets the PIM Activator, and large commits finish in seconds.

new.title: PIM Activator: you choose who
new.text: The PIM Activator page now gives ready-to-run commands, and you pick the group per channel. Nothing is assigned by default, so nobody signs in until a group is assigned.
new.action: On the PIM Activator page, assign a group for each channel so your admins can sign in.

new.title: Environment name step in Get Started
new.text: Get Started now has an Environment name step as step 2.

fixes.title: Large commits are fast
fixes.text: Committing hundreds of rows took minutes and could time out. It now takes seconds, and a slow commit is never wrongly reported as not saved.

fixes.title: New group policies no longer fail a run
fixes.text: When a new group's PIM policy cannot be read yet, PIM Manager waits and retries instead of failing the run.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Admin accounts no longer asks for a manager e-mail, as mail goes to the department's owners. The Edge for Business guide is corrected.
